nodes.description: Ownership address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner gate.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership handover (transferOwnership/acceptOwnership).
Token symbol string set in the TokenBEP20 constructor.
Token name string set in the TokenBEP20 constructor.
Token decimals (8) set in the TokenBEP20 constructor.
Total supply constant 600*10**6*10**8 minted to owner at construction.
Blocked/lock recipient address enforced by transfer and transferFrom; set in transfernewun and auto-assigned in transferFrom.
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances, mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
onlyOwner function that stages newOwner for a two-step ownership transfer.
Public function that promotes newOwner to owner after checking msg.sender == newOwner.
TokenBEP20 constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to owner.
onlyOwner setter that assigns the newun lock address.
View returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
View returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer; blocks transfers to newun, uses SafeMath sub/add on balances, emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom; mutates newun state on first call, decrements allowance, mutates balances with SafeMath.
View returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on an arbitrary spender contract, enabling callback reentrancy.
Payable fallback of TokenBEP20 that reverts on any plain ETH transfer.
onlyOwner function that transfers the entire contract ETH balance to msg.sender.
Empty payable fallback of MATPADTOKEN that accepts ETH which clearCNDAO can later drain.
Externally controlled caller address used for ownership, balances, allowances and fund withdrawal.
_owner.transfer(address(this).balance) sends the whole contract balance to msg.sender after an ownership check.
ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) external call to an attacker-controlled contract before state finalization is safe.
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control check inside the onlyOwner modifier.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) access-control check inside acceptOwnership.
SafeMath sub/add operations on balances, allowances and total supply; unchecked in older compiler semantics for the underlying math but guarded by requires.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Recipient parameter to of transfer.
Amount parameter tokens of transfer.
Parameter spender of approve.
Amount parameter tokens of approve.
Source parameter from of transferFrom.
Destination parameter to of transferFrom.
Amount parameter tokens of transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall, also the target contract of the external call.
Amount parameter tokens of approveAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata parameter data forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter _newun of transfernewun.
Local payable variable _owner = msg.sender inside clearCNDAO.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner require.
onlyOwner require gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner require gates execution of transfernewun.
onlyOwner require gates execution of clearCNDAO.
newOwner check gates execution of acceptOwnership.
msg.sender is compared with newOwner in acceptOwnership.
Parameter _newOwner is stored into the newOwner state variable.
newOwner is promoted into owner in acceptOwnership, changing privileged access.
msg.sender balance is read and decremented in transfer.
tokens parameter flows into the SafeMath sub/add updates of balances.
recipient parameter to is credited in transfer.
newun state is read to block transfers to the locked address.
balances mapping is read and written by transfer.
SafeMath sub/add arithmetic is applied to balances inside transfer.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
allowed mapping is updated by approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
from parameter is debited in transferFrom.
to parameter is credited and compared against newun in transferFrom.
tokens parameter flows into balance and allowance updates in transferFrom.
newun state is conditionally assigned and enforced in transferFrom.
allowed mapping is decremented by transferFrom.
SafeMath sub/add arithmetic is applied to balances and allowances in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balances mapping is read by balanceOf.
_totalSupply is the base value returned by totalSupply.
balances[address(0)] is subtracted from supply in totalSupply.
SafeMath sub is used to compute totalSupply.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external call target in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is written to the allowance in approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping in approveAndCall.
allowed mapping is written before the external call in approveAndCall.
approveAndCall performs an external call into an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval.
The callee contract can re-enter approveAndCall/transferFrom before allowance state is settled by the caller.
Parameter _newun is stored into the newun state variable.
clearCNDAO executes the ETH transfer of the whole contract balance.
msg.sender becomes _owner and is the recipient of the full contract balance.
Local _owner is the recipient used by the balance transfer.
msg.sender is assigned to _owner inside clearCNDAO.
The outbound ETH transfer executes the recipient fallback, which can re-enter clearCNDAO.
The MATPADTOKEN payable fallback accumulates the ETH that clearCNDAO later drains.
balances[owner] is credited with _totalSupply in the TokenBEP20 constructor.
_totalSupply is assigned into the balances mapping at construction.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner only exists to write the newOwner state in transferOwnership and should be normalized into that function.
tokenOwner is only a balance mapping index used by balanceOf.
Recipient parameter to is only consumed by the transfer balance update.
Amount parameter tokens is only consumed by the transfer SafeMath update.
spender is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
tokens is only stored into the allowance mapping inside approve.
from is only used to debit balances and allowances inside transferFrom.
to is only used to credit balances and check newun inside transferFrom.
tokens is only used in the SafeMath updates inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only an allowance mapping index used by allowance.
spender is only an allowance mapping index used by allowance.
spender is used as allowance key and as the external call target inside approveAndCall.
tokens is only written to the allowance inside approveAndCall.
data is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call inside approveAndCall.
Parameter _newun is only stored into the newun state variable by transfernewun.
Local _owner is only the msg.sender recipient used by the balance transfer in clearCNDAO.
